newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stocks end slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stocks end slightly higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed on Monday up 0.09 percent compared with the previous session, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index closed at 436.70 points compared with 436.30 points on Friday.
"Despite the slight rise registered by the bourse index, the market remained flat due to stagnation or adjustment of blue-chip companies," a Casablanca-based stockbroker said.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, closed unchanged at 500 dirhams.
But ONA's subsidiary edible oil firm Lesieur, rose 36 dirhams to close at 1,256 dirhams.
Lesieur is one of ONA's four profitable subsidiaries listed on the stock exchange.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the country's second largest private group, remained stable at 560 dirhams.
Banque Commerciale du Maroc, the market's largest capitalisation, lost four dirhams to close at 690 dirhams.
The traded volume on the official market was 22.6 million dirhams, from 25.4 million on Friday.
